rows_of: synthetic, from the seed: distinct registrable domains of 2026-10-26 under a weighted list of suffixes; first_seen synthetic, from the seed: a share 0.4 of day-precision rows of a day source (bit 8) at the start of 2026-10-26, the rest second-precision rows of a second source (bit 1) at a random second of it; no row provisional; no row suspect
read_of: readFeed of packages/feed with its defaults (block budget 2000, copy auto) and the filter suspect=exclude, over the window 2026-10-26T00:00:00Z to 2026-10-27T00:00:00Z, every read of a part and of an index of either copy counted; read_ms is Node wall time of one run in this process, not workerd CPU time, and moves with the load of the machine
